text_block_list.text:
Those summer days spent with the Rose Clan
were nothing short of a whirlwind—

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Based on the regimen you formulated, Trainer <username>,
I have selected candidates who could serve as training partners.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
In addition, using our clan's archives,
I have compiled a list of Umamusume with running styles
similar to Lady Rose's. Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
—We've secured the track for this afternoon's mock race!
All 18 runners are ready!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The strongest horse girl I ever competed against possessed astounding burst of speed and tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
From here on, rivals fierce as ferocious gods are bound to stand in your way.
You will need a weapon capable of eclipsing them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Now, run! All the way to the peak of the mountain trail!
Picture the back of the one you must surpass, sprint onward—
and hone your ultimate weapon!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes! Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you sacrifice or chase with all your heart and soul,
if you fall short by even a hair, you cannot be the victor.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I shall await you at the finish line across the beach.
Maintain your form and focus true until the very end.
No matter how agonizing it becomes, slackening is strictly forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah!
Kh...!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: —Pursue the light!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Be not one who merely reaches out, but one who seizes!
Be not one who runs alongside, but one who surpasses all!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Ngh, DAAAAAAAAGHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Thanks to the aid of everyone in the Rose clan, I have steadily grown day by day.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (I am grateful—above all else.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...How pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
—Unworthy?
Um... Rose, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... To let words slip so carelessly... what a fool I am—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I've been worried about you. You've had a gloomy look on your face for a while now. Come, just like old times.
If you'd like, why don't you talk to your big sisters?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I am... so sorry. I—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am the horse girl meant to lead the Rose Clan,
yet here I am, causing everyone such trouble and concern.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: When I ought to achieve everything with my own two hands, bringing hope through overwhelming might alone...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must lead the Rose Clan
to eternal tranquility, and yet...

text_block_list.name: The Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?!
What are you even saying?!
What on earth are you saying?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know... if only I had been stronger, that curse
would have been lifted before you ever made your debut, Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: If only I had been stronger, I could have brought the Oaks' crown home to our clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Everyone fought with everything they had. That's why it stings so much, and why we want our dreams to come true.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lending a hand.
I'm making a dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Please, make my dream... come true—

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Until now, I resolved to merely watch over you, believing it to be a matter between you and your Trainer—yet in truth, I had longed to help all along.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
The day we got the call, everyone's eyes were sparkling
at the thought that we could finally do something.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: You are the Umamusume who rules the Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Yet in that kingdom, you have us.
We are here, chasing the dream alongside you.

Through days of rigorous training alongside the Rose Clan,
Rose Kingdom's abilities blossomed at an astonishing pace.
Above all else—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So this is where you were.
—Trainer.

Before I knew it, the tight set of their lips
had softened back into a gentle composure.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I have done you a grave discourtesy.
Keeping what mattered most locked within my heart,
never allowing you near it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: There is something I want you to hear.

Waves lapped against the shore and receded.
Rose Kingdom began to speak, her words falling in quiet, measured drops.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This spring, I was deeply moved by Pisa's triumph.
Truly, it was a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Her figure overlapped with that of the Wise King Moss.
...I believe it gave me a push forward.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: That long-held wish blazed all the brighter. If I give everything to bring hope, the future will surely open before us.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I can lead the Rose Clan into a peaceful future.
—Nay, it is I who shall lead them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: At the Fan Appreciation Festival, I could never have brought hope to everyone all on my own.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In the mock race,
I was made painfully aware of my own shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I could not become like King Moss the Wise.
It felt as though there was not a single trait we shared.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I resolved to become even stronger. And spending this summer that way... an epiphany struck me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wondered if the ideal king I should aspire to be... was a wise monarch like Moss.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I spent a summer alongside the Rose Clan,
feeling their immense passion and power firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: My dream was their dream as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Is guiding people such as them... what I am truly meant to do?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is the king they truly need...
one who guides them, I wonder?

—
A certain phrase came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text: This summer, let us demonstrate it. The true, unyielding mettle of the House of the Rose.

The reason I rushed to the main estate that day
was because I wanted her to remember that the Rose Clan
is someone she can always depend on.
choice_data_list: (No. "Reliable" doesn't even begin to cover it.)

text_block_list.text: What guided her through that summer was none other than the unyielding mettle of her family—the House of the Rose, which had persevered, relentlessly weaving an unchanging dream.

The Rose Clan is not weak. Therefore, the ruler we need
is not one who leads through sheer force and cunning.
choice_data_list: ...A king who walks alongside her people.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Walking... together...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—In other words,
...not to lead, but to join hands—?
Over the past few years, I had come to understand her far better.

Splendidly shattering a thorny curse of over ten years,
she defeated the queen of the era in the Japan Cup,
echoing the name of the Rose Kingdom far and wide.

From the day we met, she loved her clan more than anyone,
facing the future entirely for their sake.

Her devotion was plain for all to see.
Which was precisely why the clan entrusted their long-cherished wish to her—

And this summer, when she found herself in dire straits,
every single member of the clan reached out to lend a hand.

Rose Kingdom had not been burdened with
such an immense wish from the moment she was born.
Born into this world as merely a single Umamusume—

Loving her clan and beloved by them in return,
she became the one to shoulder all their long-cherished desires.
choice_data_list: —I'm telling you this simply as one human being.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: “As a fellow human being”...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: If it's 'you,' you can do it. I believe that too.
If it's 'you,' you can do it. I believe that too.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...Ah, I see.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
My duty is to march toward the future alongside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To seize glory together.
And with that hope, to forge a path to the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I do not know if I can do it.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My heart burns with conviction.
I want to see this through, alongside everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: As a proud daughter of the Rose Clan, carrying our long-cherished ambition!

Murmuring those words, she looked up at the sky—
and a faint glimmer reflected in her eyes.
And a few days later—

I found myself visiting the main estate of
the Rose Clan alongside Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...*Phew*—
...All right.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us bid farewell...
to you, wise King Moss.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You were my ideal, and you were my friend.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: For serving as the sanctuary of my heart and delivering me from doubt time and again, you have my deepest gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I shall hold the people in my heart just as you do,
yet devote myself to them in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the Rose Clan,
and together with the Trainer who stands before me,
we shall carve open a future of eternal peace.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Moss.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Farewell.
With our parting, summer came to an end.

And so, once more—
yet another new path opens before us.
